info.name: spring-ai-rag-advanced
info.description: ETL pipeline + modular RAG over a MariaDB vector store. Run with the 'mysql' profile (needs MariaDB 11.7+ and Ollama with llama3.2 + all-minilm).

item.name: ETL pipeline
item.description: Extract (PagePdfDocumentReader) -> Transform (TokenTextSplitter) -> Load (VectorStore). Reads every PDF under app.rag.ingestion.location (default classpath:docs/*.pdf).

item.name: RAG chat (per-user memory via X-User-Id header)
item.description: The X-User-Id header value becomes the chat-memory conversation id, so every user has an isolated RAG conversation. Missing header -> 400. Answers are grounded on whatever /rag/ingest has loaded into the vector store.
